name: Hampton Inn Tropicana

sources.observed: Official images1,12,5 visually inspected: cream/terracotta exterior, green hip crowns, brick base, covered arrival; lobby with wood reception counters, ring chandelier, lounge; breakfast space with magenta wall, mustard seating and buffet. Image7 inspected: irregular pool, rock waterfall, timber lounge chairs with blue cushions and substantial palms/planting. These landscape details are not yet fully modelled. Image6 additionally inspected on 2026-10-27: rock feature is at the side of basin, courtyard framed by palms/shrubs, green-roofed rear entrance and firepit seating; present placement remains approximate.
Satellite inspected: rotated parallel wings around southwest-facing pool courtyard; northeast arrival facing Dean Martin. Source dates vary.

Courtyard porch with six brick piers and raised central hip roof; closed rear glazing, original folded-leaf hedge geometry, bark and sedimentary rock maps. Removed regular trunk rings and corrected walking route around a lounge chair. Canopy placement/dimensions inferred from official image6.
